message.content:
**Uno – Basic Rules (Standard Edition)** | Item | Details | |------|---------| | **Objective** | Be the first player to score 500 points (or agree on another target). Points are earned by being the first to discard all cards in your hand and then scoring the sum of the remaining cards in opponents’ hands. | | **Deck** | 108 cards: 4 colors (Red, Yellow, Green, Blue) × 25 cards each (one 0, two 1‑9, two “Draw Two”, two “Skip”, two “Reverse”), plus 8 Wild cards (4 “Wild”, 4 “Wild Draw Four”). | | **Setup** | • Shuffle the deck.
• Deal 7 cards to each player.
• Place the remaining deck face down as the draw pile.
• Flip the top card of the draw pile onto the discard pile; if it’s a special card, apply its effect immediately (e.g., if a “Draw Two” starts the game, the first player draws two cards and loses their turn). | | **Turn Sequence** | 1. **Draw Phase** – If you cannot play a card from your hand, you must draw one card from the draw pile. If that drawn card is playable, you may play it immediately; otherwise, keep it and end your turn.
2. **Play Phase** – Play one or more cards from your hand that match either the color, number, or symbol of the top discard card. You may also play a Wild card at any time.
3. **End Turn** – After playing, discard any remaining cards you wish to play (you can play multiple cards in a single turn if they’re all legal). Then pass the turn to the next player in the current direction. | | **Playable Cards** | • **Number cards** – Match color or number.
• **Action cards** – “Skip”, “Reverse”, “Draw Two”: Must match color or be played as a Wild.
• **Wild cards** – “Wild” (choose new color), “Wild Draw Four” (choose new color + force next player to draw four unless challenged). | | **Special Actions** | • **Skip** – Next player loses their turn.
• **Reverse** – Reverses the order of play (in a 2‑player game, acts like Skip).
• **Draw Two** – Next player draws two cards and loses their turn.
• **Wild** – Player chooses the next color.
• **Wild Draw Four** – Same as Wild but forces next player to draw four cards and lose their turn. It can only be played if the player has no other playable card of the current color; otherwise, the play can be challenged. | | **Winning a Round** | When a player discards their last card, the round ends. That player scores points equal to the total value of all cards left in opponents’ hands:
• Number cards: face value.
• Action cards (“Skip”, “Reverse”, “Draw Two”): 20 points each.
• Wild cards: 50 points each. | | **Scoring & Game End** | Add the round score to the winner’s cumulative total. The first player to reach the agreed point threshold (commonly 500) wins the game. | | **Optional House Rules** | • **Stacking** – Allow players to stack “Draw Two” or “Wild Draw Four” cards instead of drawing.
• **No Challenge** – Disallow challenges to “Wild Draw Four”.
• **Card‑Up** – Players must say “UNO” when they have one card left; failure results in a penalty (draw two).
• **Custom Decks** – Use Uno variants (e.g., Uno Attack, Uno Spin). | **Key Strategy Tips** 1. Keep track of which colors have been played to anticipate opponents’ options. 2. Save Wild cards for moments when you’re stuck or to change the color to suit your hand. 3. Pay attention to the “UNO” rule—if someone forgets to call it, you can challenge them and make them draw two cards. That covers the core gameplay! Feel free to ask about specific house rules or variations.
